title: SWEN3204 Software Architecture – Assignment 2: Short-Answer Questions
overview: Answer six short questions applying architecture concepts to the CampusEats scenario. The assignment is worth 40 marks, including 4 marks for communication. Submit an individual, single-document response.
deliverables: Answers to Questions 1–6, each under its required heading and in order.
Show calculations and working for all parts of Question 3.
Include IEEE-style citations for external sources and a reference list at the end.

format.length: Each answer must be at most 150 words; Question 3 calculations and working, and the reference list, are excluded from the limit.
format.structure: Use the headings “Question 1” through “Question 6”, in order. Place the reference list at the end.
format.other: Submit one document; this is an individual assignment. State any assumptions. Give availability as percentages to two decimal places and downtime in hours to one decimal place.

requirements.text: Question 1: Identify the two most important quality attributes for CampusEats and justify each choice using the scenario. For each attribute, provide a quality attribute scenario with all six parts: source, stimulus, artefact, environment, response, and a measurable response measure.

Question 2: Recommend an architectural style for the next 12 months (for example, monolith, modular monolith, or microservices). Justify the recommendation with at least two trade-offs specific to CampusEats.

Question 3: Show your working. Calculate (a) order-placement availability using the component availabilities and independent failures, (b) expected order-placement downtime in hours per 30-day month, and (c) end-to-end availability and monthly downtime when a second independent payment provider of 99.5% availability is added active-active, with payment unavailable only when both providers are down.

Question 4: Name one architectural resilience pattern that could contain the slow-payment-provider failure. Explain how it works and would limit the outage, and state at least one drawback or tuning consideration.

Question 5: For menu browsing and for placing and paying for an order, choose whether to favour availability or consistency during a network partition. Justify each choice with reference to CAP theorem and name one concrete technique for each.

Question 6: Write a short ADR for introducing a message queue between order payment and outlet notification. Include Context, Decision, and Consequences, with at least one positive and one negative consequence.
State any assumptions made. Cite external sources in IEEE style and include the corresponding reference list; references do not count toward answer word limits.
